injectVault()

The injectVault() function provides access to the strongly typed FeatureCell vault instance associated with an Angular @FeatureCell-decorated service. It is the primary and only supported mechanism for retrieving a FeatureCell’s runtime API inside Angular.

Injection Contract Summary

  • Angular-only API
  • Requires a @FeatureCell()-decorated class
  • Must be called inside the FeatureCell service constructor or initializer
  • Returns a fully typed FeatureCellShape<T>
  • Requires prior registration via provideFeatureCell()

injectVault() does not create or register a FeatureCell. It resolves an existing FeatureCell instance from Angular dependency injection using metadata written by the @FeatureCell decorator.

Note

injectVault() may only be used within the owning FeatureCell service. Attempting to inject the same FeatureCell into multiple services or outside a @FeatureCell-decorated class is invalid and results in a runtime error.

Usage

A FeatureCell is typically declared as an Angular service. The @FeatureCell decorator defines the cell’s identity and state type, while injectVault<T>() retrieves the corresponding vault instance.

The vault must be injected once per FeatureCell and must be stored on the service instance. Injection is synchronous and safe during construction.

Example: Declaring an Angular FeatureCell

{{`// app.config.ts

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideVault({ logLevel: 'off' }),

    provideFeatureCell(
      EmployeeService,
      {
        key: 'employees',
        initialState: [] 
      }
    )
  ]
};
          
// bank-employee.service.ts
// The provideFeatureCell key must match the @FeatureCell key input
          
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FeatureCell, injectVault } from '@sdux-vault/angular';
import { Employee } from './employee.shape';

@FeatureCell<Employee[]>('employees')
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class EmployeeService {

  // Use injectVault to get an instance of the FeatureCell
  readonly vault = injectVault<Employee[]>(EmployeeService);

  constructor() {
    // Required to activate the FeatureCell
    this.vault.initialize();
  }
}`}}

What this does

  • Associates the service with a FeatureCell key
  • Resolves the correct FeatureCell vault from Angular DI
  • Provides a fully typed FeatureCell runtime API
  • Ensures the FeatureCell is initialized exactly once
Rules & Constraints
  • Must be called inside a @FeatureCell-decorated service
    The function relies on static metadata written by the decorator.
  • Must receive the FeatureCell class reference
    Passing the class allows SDuX to resolve the correct DI token.
  • May only be used once per FeatureCell
    A FeatureCell vault is owned by exactly one service instance.
  • Requires prior registration
    provideFeatureCell() must run before injection occurs.

Violating any of these constraints results in a controlled runtime error to prevent ambiguous ownership or invalid FeatureCell lifecycles.

Configuration
Injection API
Function Description
injectVault<T>

inputs:

  • featureCellClass: Class

return:

  • FeatureCellShape<T>
Resolves and injects the FeatureCell vault associated with the given @FeatureCell-decorated class. The returned object exposes the complete FeatureCell runtime API.
FeatureCellShape<T>

A FeatureCell exposes a stable runtime surface defined by the FeatureCellShape<T> contract. This shape represents the complete public interaction surface for configuring behaviors, observing state, and issuing state updates after registration.
